maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is recurring subscription fees for cloud HCM, payroll and HR software, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are private employers (healthcare, hospitality, retail, franchisees) paying software fees; government is not the main payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Growth comes from selling its single-database platform organically and adding product features, not from regular acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Payroll and HR core system holds employee data and runs payroll; switching means migration, retraining, compliance risk and payroll disruption.
